theorems.name: Submission.codim1_zsl_gbl_blowUp_mass_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (xs : ℕ → Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ i, 0 < lams i), Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → (∃ C r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball x r₀, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r₀ → T.massOn (ball y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)) → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ ball 0 R → (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y) ≤ 1) → currentEval (blowUp T (xs i) (lams i) (hlams i).ne') (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ≤ c
